investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the venue's own official homepage directly contains 20 schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks (WordPress + a calendar plugin, server-rendered — no JS execution needed to read them). ingestion/json-ld/'s existing filterMusicEventNodes() then honestly separates genuine named-act music programming from generic/placeholder entries (weekly summary placeholders, an art exhibition, unnamed karaoke/open-mic nights).

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://sinestesia.barcelona/reload/ directly exposed 20 real schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks with explicit dates, several with named performers/acts — no browser/headless escalation was needed.

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence at https://sinestesia.barcelona/.

site_classification.platform: WordPress + a calendar/events plugin ('mec-events' custom post type observed in this site's own public REST API, /wp-json/wp/v2/types) emitting schema.org Event JSON-LD directly on the homepage.

title.notes: Each Event node's own 'name'. This venue is a MIXED programme (an occasional exhibition, weekly generic summary placeholder posts like 'semana 33/2026', karaoke/open-mic nights with no named performer, alongside genuine named-act music nights) — this package's collector applies ingestion/json-ld/'s existing filterMusicEventNodes() to keep only the latter, honestly rejecting the rest (never guessing a generic placeholder into 'music').

start_date.notes: Each Event node's own 'startDate', a plain 'YYYY-MM-DD' calendar date — DATE_ONLY.

time.notes: startDate carries a date only, no time-of-day.

end.notes: Each Event node's own 'endDate', also DATE_ONLY.

venue_location.notes: Each Event node's own 'location.name' == 'SINESTESIA' (a single physical venue) — resolved by source_id, matching this project's existing single-venue JSON-LD pattern.

source_record_id.notes: Each Event node's own 'url' (its own permalink) — used as the stable identifier, matching this project's existing antilla-bcn-barcelona/moog-barcelona precedent for a JSON-LD source with no numeric id field.

price.notes: Each node's own 'offers.price' is genuinely present but empty-string on every sampled record.

reasons: acquisition_class JSON_LD_EVENT, a resolved supported class.
A CONFIRMED public data path retained (20 real Event nodes observed live at proof time, 5 passing the existing music-relevance filter).
title and start_date both PROVEN, directly stated by the source.
source_record_id PROVEN via the node's own stable permalink URL.
recommended_family JSON_LD — completely reuses ingestion/json-ld/ unchanged, no new module needed at all.

evidence.description: The venue's own real, live homepage HTML, containing 20 real schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks.
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: This package's own offline test suite (tests/sinestesia.test.mjs) re-parses the retained evidence above with ingestion/json-ld/ (unchanged) and asserts the exact music-relevance filter outcome recorded above.
